title: Streamlining Vaccination-differentiated Safe Management Measures for Coffee Shops and Canteens
what_it_is: Streamlining Vaccination-differentiated Safe Management Measures for Coffee Shops and Canteens

sections.label: Coffeeshop and canteen dine-in rules
sections.summary: From 29 March 2022, coffeeshops and canteens may allow five diners without VDS checks or 10 diners with at-entry VDS checks.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: As part of the further relaxation of safe management measures (SMMs) from 29 March 2022, coffeeshops and canteens can either choose to accommodate up to five persons dine-in without at-entry Vaccination-Differentiated Safe Management Measures (VDS) checks or accommodate up to 10 persons dine-in with at-entry VDS checks.

sections.label: SFA plans, checks and SME support
sections.summary: Operators submit plans to SFA, 237 coffee shops and canteens use 10-person VDS, checks continue, and SMEs get one-off cash support.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: Operators will have to submit their plans to SFA and will receive a response within seven working days.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: As of 29 March 2022, there are 237 coffee shops and canteens implementing the 10-person VDS.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: SFA and Safe Distancing Ambassadors will continue to conduct regular checks at coffee shops and canteens to ensure that VDS requirements are strictly adhered to.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: The Government will also be providing a one-off cash support to Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) that have been most affected by the COVID-19 restrictions and measures over the past year, including the F&B sector, under the Small Business Recovery Grant.

sections.label: VDS review and Geylang Serai pasar malam
sections.summary: On further review, VDS will be aligned with MTF decisions, and arrangements like Geylang Serai's pasar malam will be looked at over time.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: On further review of VDS, as explained by the Minister for Health earlier on, it will be aligned with what has been decided by MTF.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: As we have seen recently, Geylang Serai, for example, has a pasar malam.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: We will look at such arrangements, over time, as the situation allows.
